thread:
sanjay: paging from incident-bot — multiple kv_cache_eviction alerts spiking since 02:01 UTC, tail latencies climbing for user-facing routes. getting paged repeatedly. anyone oncall?
incident-bot: Incident created (sev=2) — kv_cache_eviction_rate > 5% for 3m across region-us-west. Pagerduty incident: PD-7891
pagerduty: Sanjay is on call (primary) — escalation: Maria (secondary) will be notified if unresolved in 10m
sanjay: quick check: dashboards show eviction rate up to 12% on a few shards and hit-rate dropped from 98% -> 84% on reads for seq < 512. CPU on GPU nodes normal. not seeing sudden traffic spike, looks cache-related.
elaine: on my way, pulling logs. any recent deploys to cache config?
maria: I rolled a small config change to eviction_policy last night but it was gated to canary only. not global. I'll check canary telemetry.
sanjay: can we temp-squelch eviction alerts so we stop paging while we triage? high noise is drowning important follow-ups.
elaine: +1 please set a suppress window. propose: suppress kv_cache_eviction alert for 30m for now and raise lat p99 watch alerts only.
incident-bot: Alert suppression applied by sanjay — kv_cache_eviction suppressed for 30m.
ale x: posting suggested quick mitigations:
```
# 1) Temporarily increase cache size on hot shard pool
kubectl patch statefulset cache-hot -p "{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\":[{\"name\":\"cache\",\"resources\":{\"limits\":{\"memory\":\"+4Gi\"}}}]}}}}"
# 2) Disable aggressive LRU by setting eviction_policy=LRU-lite for 15m
# 3) Route critical customer traffic to read-through fallback pool
```
ale x: I can run 1 & 2 now if folks greenlight.
maria: runbook? what's the safety rollback?
sanjay: rollback = revert memory patch + restore eviction_policy to previous value. I'll hold the revert step if latencies improve.
elaine: I'm seeing a heatmap — evictions concentrated on partitions serving short-seq chat completions. eviction churn correlates with increased embed requests from one customer 'acme-ads'.
maria: acme-ads on heavy burst today, can we throttle them at edge for next 15m?
sanjay: yes, adding a temporary rate-limit rule for customer: acme-ads -> 50rps. applying now.
incident-bot: Rate-limit rule applied by sanjay — acme-ads throttled to 50rps.
elaine: after increasing cache to +4Gi and flipping eviction_policy, hit-rate climbed from 84% -> 95% on affected shards over 6m. p99 latency back to baseline.
sanjay: good. reducing suppression to 10m, but we need permanent fixes: alert tuning + hit-rate dashboard + runbook updates.
maria: agree. current alert fires on absolute eviction_rate > 5% which is noisy during deploys and planned bursts. propose: switch alert to a two-stage rule: (eviction_rate > 5% for 5m AND hit_rate_drop >= 8pct) OR (eviction_rate > 12% immediate). Also add a deploy/maintenance mute window integration.
ale x: I'll make a dashboard which shows: evictions, hit_rate (by shard), top 10 keys by churn, recent deploys overlay, and customer request heatmap. Will add target lines and 1h/6h baseline ribbons.
elaine: also we should add an automated mitigation action to the alert: before paging, attempt a graceful cache resize or route to fallback pool if available. document tradeoffs.
sanjay: assigning follow-ups: 
- alex: dashboard + grafana panels, add baseline ribbons, query examples.
- elaine: runbook + automated mitigation playbook (cache resize + fallback routing).
- maria: update alert rules in prometheus: two-stage rule + maintenance window integration.
- sanjay: post-incident writeup and customer comms for acme-ads.
maria: ETA: I can push alert PR in ~2 hours. I'll include query snippet:
```
# PromQL candidate
avg_over_time(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]) / avg_over_time(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]) * 100 > 5
and
(kv_cache_hit_rate <= (avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_rate[1h]) - 0.08))
```
ale x: dashboard panels sketched, will PR by EOD.
elaine: runbook draft will include thresholds, mitigations, and required safety checks (memory available, fallback pool health). I'll add a note to suppress alerts automatically during known deploy windows.
sanjay: good work team. I'll draft customer note for acme-ads and set a follow-up meeting tomorrow to review alert noise reduction metrics and the new dashboard.
incident-bot: Incident PD-7891 marked resolved by sanjay — mitigation succeeded. root cause suspected: bursty tenant causing excessive eviction churn; config + capacity mismatch.
maria: thanks everyone. will add tests to simulate bursty key churn in staging.
ale x: quick FYI — created a private grafana folder: /dashboards/kv-cache/hitrate-summaries (will share link after PR merges).
elaine: logging an action item for SRE-runbook board: SRE-1287 "Cache eviction alert tuning + automated mitigations"
sanjay: closing thread for now. please add any postmortem notes in the doc I created: /incidents/PD-7891-kv-eviction-2026-03-15
